29:12: In order to sustain you today before Him as His people, and He will be for you a God
and as He promised your forefathers
29:17: Perhaps there is among you a man or a woman or offspring or a tribe whose thoughts stray today from the fear of Adonoy, our God,
lest there is within you a man who imagines sin or evil.
29:18: When he hears the statements of this oath-curse, he will think to himself, saying, ‘‘Peace will be my lot
when I shall follow what my thoughts envision,’’
so that I will add unintentional sins to the intentional.
29:19: Adonoy will be unwilling to forgive him,
because then Adonoy’s anger and His vengeful fury will be aroused against that man,
and there will cling to him the entire oath-curse
and Adonoy will eliminate his name
29:21: The latter generation will say — your children who will arise after you
and the foreign alien who will come from a distant land;
and they will see the plagues of that land and its illnesses
that Adonoy has harmed it with.
29:23: And all the nations will say,
‘‘For what did Adonoy do so to this land?
Why the vigor of this great anger?’’
29:27: And Adonoy forced them away from their land
with anger and wrath and great anger;
and He exiled them into another land like this day.
30:2: You will return to the fear of Adonoy, your God, and accept His word
exactly as I am commanding you today,
wholeheartedly and with your whole being.
30:3: Adonoy, your God, will bring back your returnees of your exile and will be merciful toward you;
and He will return and gather you
from all the peoples that Adonoy, your God, has dispersed you there.
30:4: If your exiled one will be at the edge of the heavens,
from there will Adonoy, your God, gather you
and from there will He bring you near.
30:6: And Adonoy, your God, will remove the foolishness from your heart and the foolishness from the heart of your descendants,
to love Adonoy, your God, wholeheartedly and with all your being in order that you live.
30:8: and you will perform all His commandments
that I am commanding you today.
30:9: Adonoy, your God, will give you surplus in all your endeavors, in the offspring of your belly, and in the offspring of your animals, and in the fruit of your soil — for benefit;
for Adonoy will return to rejoice over you for benefit
as He rejoiced over your forefathers.
30:10: When you accept the word of Adonoy, your God,
to guard His commandments and His statutes,
when you turn back to Adonoy, your God,
wholeheartedly and with all your being.
30:16: For which I command you this day,
to love Adonoy, your God, to go in the ways proper before Him
and to guard His commandments and His statutes and His laws;
and you will live and you will flourish,
and Adonoy, your God, will bless you
in the land that you are coming there to inherit.
30:17: But if your heart strays and you do not accept,
and you are misled, and you prostrate yourself to idols of the nations and worship them.
30:18: you will not remain long on the land
that you are crossing the Yardein
30:20: to accept His word and to cling to the fear of Him;
for He is your life and your longevity,
to live on the soil that Adonoy swore to your forefathers — to Avrohom, to Yitzchok, and to Yaakov — to give them.
